notes: Seed (2023-10-03, USD 5M) led by AgFunder with Cherubic Ventures; 'existing pre-seed investors from the US and Europe' also took part, but no pre-seed amount or date was found. Third-party trackers give totals of USD 5M or USD 7M.

Bruker took a minority stake (announced 2026-08-14, terms undisclosed) alongside a collaboration that put Bruker benchtop NMR into the Boston autonomous lab, which opened in early 2026 with Chemspeed robotics.

Site footer now reads 'Atinary Technologies Inc.' (a US entity), while LinkedIn and the 2023 seed coverage place HQ in Lausanne/Epalinges, Vaud. The Swiss registry (zefix/moneyhouse) was not checked for lack of time, so board changes are unknown.
About page: 'With 13 nationalities represented' (no headcount). LinkedIn grew from 17 (2024-07) to 22 (2025-11) people, so the team stayed small after the seed.

Current openings are on Zoho Recruit (atinary.zohorecruit.eu), linked from the careers page, with posting dates shown there. A 'Talent Community' general application (2026-10-05) is excluded from the count.
